basic_info.description: Positioned on a Cole Valley block graced with outlooks to the desirable open space of Sutro Forest, yet close to many urban amenities, this period home boasts pristine finishes and period charm preserved by the finest of stewardship.  Perfectly organized for both entertaining and privacy, the traditional floor plan incorporates an open living space enhanced by well-preserved period details including hardwood floors, a wood-burning firepl, coved ceilings and a large bay window. The adjoining spacious kitchen includes stone countertops and a brkfst bar with a serene view of the west-facing deck, expansive garden and the majestic forest bey. The main living level also accommodates 2 nicely sized bedrooms and 1 baths. An interior connection to the garage provides a secure connection to the lower flr which offers great potential for more living space plus 2 car parking. The lovely west-facing garden, enjoys serene surrounding vistas provided by Sutro Forest, an extraordinary natural landscape in the heart of San Francisco.   Cole Valley, among the most coveted of SF neighborhoods, is defined by hillside topography laced with tree-lined streets and period architecture and convenient access to an array of village services, MUNI and the world class museums and open space of GG Park.
